quarterly_data.signal: Cloudflare 10-K (fiscal 2025): revenue increased $498.3 million, or 30%, driven by a 40% increase in paying customers to 332,466 (4,298 paying more than $100,000) and a dollar-based net retention rate of 120% in Q4; gross margin 75%; channel partners 26% of revenue; capital expenditures of $315.6 million; RPO $2,495.8 million, 63% expected over the next 12 months. It is deploying GPUs across its global network for AI-related developer platform products, and expects significant component shortages in its server supply chain during the year, particularly DIMMs, enterprise SSDs, CPUs and high-capacity HDDs, driven by the reallocation of manufacturing capacity to AI infrastructure and hyperscale demand.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue +30% ($498.3 million); 332,466 paying customers; capex $315.6 million; RPO $2,495.8 million
